output.answer: 5.3 − 3.8 = 1.5. Work: Line up the decimal points: 5.3 minus 3.8. Tenths: 3 tenths is less than 8 tenths, so I regroup 1 one as 10 tenths, giving 13 tenths. 13 tenths − 8 tenths = 5 tenths. Ones: 4 ones − 3 ones = 1 one. So the answer is 1.5.
